notes.text:
This update for busybox fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2023-42366: heap-buffer-overflow in the next_token function (bsc#1217586).
- CVE-2026-38752: Denial of Service via crafted AWK script (bsc#1271544).
- CVE-2026-38753: use-after-free in awk_sub() (bsc#1271545).
- CVE-2026-38754: heap overflow in ifsbreakup() (bsc#1271547).
- CVE-2026-38755: heap overflow in evalcommand() (bsc#1271548).
